title: Grouppass
description:
Grouppass is a special kind of UiTPAS concept: it has an `uitpasNumber` like regular passholders, but it can only participate in ticket sale flows (either social tariff or using coupons). 

The social tariff for grouppasses is a little bit different from regular passholders, because a grouppass is entitled to buy a certain amount of `totalTicketsPerYear`, of which the remaining amount is indicated by `availableTickets`.

A grouppass cannot check-in at events, or redeem rewards.

A `Grouppass` can be identified by its `id`. However, there are cases where the grouppass is identified using its UiTPAS number. Every grouppass has one (and only one) uitpas number.

id.description: This field is always available in responses.

uitpasNumber.description: The UiTPAS number of this grouppass. This field is always available in responses.

name.description: Name of the grouppass. Not available when the caller is identified with client identification.

cardStatus.description: Status of the card linked to this grouppass.

email.description: Contact email address of the grouppass. Not available when the caller is identified with client identification.

creationDate.description: This field is always available in responses.

socialTariff.description: Social tariff of the grouppass (if applicable)

status.description:
Status of the social tariff:
- `ACTIVE`: the grouppass is entitled to social tariff
- `EXPIRED`: the grouppass is NOT entitled to social tariff anymore

endDate.description: Exact moment the grouppass's right to a social tariff expires.

totalTicketsPerYear.description: Total number of tickets this grouppass can buy per year.

address.description: Address of the grouppass. Not available when the caller is identified with client identification.

street.description: Full street name, number and box of the grouppass

telephone.description: Telephone contact number of this grouppass. Not available when the caller is identified with client identification.

CardSystem.title: CardSystem
CardSystem.description: A region, usually one or multiple municipalities in Belgium, that uses UiTPAS and provides discounts and/or rewards. For example "Paspartoe" (Brussels), UiTPAS Leuven, UiTPAS Hasselt, UiTPAS Gent, and so on.

name.description: Name of the card system. This field is always available in responses.

branding.description: Branding information of the card system

logo.description: URL to the logo of the card system

primaryColor.description: Color code of the primary branding color.

secondaryColor.description: Color code of the secondary branding color.

website.description: URL of the website of the card system

cities.description: List of cities that are part of this card system

permanent.description: Indicates whether this is a permanent card system

allowsCardlessRegistration.description: Indicates if cardless registration is enabled

cardlessRegistrationType.description: Indicates the types of online cardless registrations this cardsystem supports.

socialTariffInfo.description: Optional information about social tariff entitlement in this card system.
